Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [When Attacking] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards in the hand.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 card in my hand for this card's [When Attacking] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect can only be activated after the attack declaration and before the counter timing.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's effect after I attack with it and resolve all battles and checks?
